what_happened: Dispatch's premise pre-verification held up under independent re-derivation: the harvest-and-widen merge in update-task-status.sh is real and additive, and exactly one live call site (skill_postflight_update in skill-base.sh) reaches it -- orchestrator-postflight.sh's parallel Stage 7 branch is confirmed dead code via its own header comment. This let research converge quickly on recommending dispatch option (a) (a single stderr notice at the two update_state_json() merge points, gated on the post-merge delta rather than the raw forwarded list) without needing to re-litigate the originating change request's framing.
